Backend: Express API `backend/index.js`; routes `backend/src/routes/`, controllers `backend/src/controllers/`, repositories `backend/src/repositories/`. `RepositoryFactory` selects JSON-file or Mongo implementations. Menu routes use multer `upload.single("image")`.

Frontend: React in `frontend/src/`; admin UI `frontend/src/pages/admin/` (e.g. `adminhomes.jsx`). API client `frontend/src/lib/api.js` uses `fetch`, `credentials: 'include'`, detects `FormData`, unwraps responses (do not set `Content-Type` manually). Always double check `credentials: 'include'`.

Auth is cookie-first: never rely on localStorage tokens in production; production expects httpOnly cookies. Images use local filesystem or Cloudinary; check `backend/.env` (`IMAGE_STORAGE_TYPE`, `CLOUDINARY_*`) and `backend/.env.examples`.

Read `backend/src/routes/*.js`, `backend/src/controllers/*`, `backend/src/repositories/repository.factory.js`, `backend/.env.examples`, `frontend/src/lib/api.js`, `frontend/src/pages/admin/adminhomes.jsx`. For multer routes, frontend must not set `Content-Type` header explicitly when sending FormData. Setting `Content-Type` manually will break boundary generation.

Tests: `backend/src/__tests__` use `supertest`, app export from `backend/index.js`, someti
